newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian budget assumes 5,560 rbl/dlr exchange rate.
newsitem.headline: Russian budget assumes 5,560 rbl/dlr exchange rate.

text.p: Russia's draft 1997 budget assumes an average exchange rate of 5,560 roubles per dollar, according to a copy of the draft obtained by Reuters on Tuesday.
The 1996 budget assumed an exchange rate of 5,500 roubles.
Under Russia's crawling peg exchange rate policy, which runs until the end of this year, the rouble should be trading in a 5,500-6,100 per dollar corridor on December 31 of this year.
It was quoted at 5,366/69 in late trading on Tuesday.
The document, drawn up on August 22, included the following economic assumptions for 1997.
- real change in GDP: -1 to +1 percent
